name: Use of Externally-Controlled Format String
principle: Passing externally supplied text as a printf-style format argument lets the attacker control directive parsing. That can disclose memory, corrupt memory, or crash the process.
detection_signals: printf/fprintf/sprintf/snprintf/syslog/vprintf family call where the format argument is a variable, not a string literal
format variable is tainted from argv[], getenv(), fgets(), recv(), read(), file input, or locale/message resource data
direct pattern like printf(user), fprintf(fp, user), snprintf(buf, n, user), syslog(pri, user)
variadic forwarding where vprintf/vfprintf/vsprintf/vsnprintf/vsyslog receives a user-controlled fmt
format string assembled by strcat/sprintf/snprintf concatenation with external fragments before the call
dynamic format source contains or accepts %n, %x, %p, or %s directives
negative_signals: format argument is a string literal and user data is passed as a separate argument, e.g. printf("%s", user)
non-format output API is used, e.g. fputs(), puts(), fwrite(), write(), std::cout << user
allowed dynamic formatting is mapped from an enum or whitelist to fixed literal templates
syslog/printer call uses a literal format with explicit arguments, e.g. syslog(pri, "%s", msg)
length-bounded printing still uses a literal format, e.g. snprintf(buf, n, "%.*s", len, user)
false_defense_traps: using snprintf/vsnprintf does not help if the format argument is attacker-controlled
stripping only %n still leaves %x/%s/%p for memory disclosure and crashes
escaping % to %% is insufficient if the resulting string is later re-used as a format
treating error, log, or localization messages as safe even when they are parsed as format strings
verification_focus: Is any printf-style format argument non-literal and reachable from external input?

consequence_chains.trigger: attacker-controlled format can reach %n or another write-capable directive with a writable pointer argument on the stack

patch_principle: Use a constant format string and pass external text only as data arguments
Replace format-string APIs with non-format output APIs when formatting is unnecessary
If dynamic formatting is required, select from a fixed allowlist of templates only
Disable or avoid %n-capable formatting where possible
Enable compiler format warnings such as -Wformat and -Wformat-security
